clauses.body: Calculator users need to convert decimal numbers to hexadecimal in the existing calculator interaction. The measurable outcome is that a positive integer entered through that interaction can be converted to an equivalent base-16 value.

The implementation includes conversion of positive integer decimal inputs to their equivalent hexadecimal representation through the existing calculator interaction. The requested screenshot and automated test results are acceptance evidence for this capability, not evidence that has already been produced. Unrelated UI redesign and additional calculator operations are excluded. The requested screenshot and test results are explicitly in scope: provide a screenshot of a successful representative conversion and automated test results for valid inputs and relevant invalid or boundary cases.

For a supported positive integer decimal input, a user can invoke conversion in the existing calculator interaction and see its mathematically equivalent base-16 representation. Verify by exercising representative inputs and comparing the displayed value with the expected hexadecimal value. Letter casing and prefix remain undecided.

Retain a screenshot showing a successful representative positive-integer decimal-to-hexadecimal conversion in the existing calculator interaction. The representative value is deferred; select and record it before treating the screenshot check as executable.

Retain automated test results covering valid positive-integer inputs and relevant invalid or boundary cases. Define concrete vectors and expected invalid/boundary behavior after the deferred decisions below; do not treat this criterion as executable until those are settled.
